warning_source: Maj. Gen. (res.) Yitzhak Brik / serving IDF soldiers’ complaints commissioner
progress: Direct contemporaneous letter warned of severe IDF war-readiness deficiencies and demanded an independent external review; contemporaneous reporting records Brik’s assessment that readiness was worse than before the Yom Kippur War. Netanyahu later met Brik and convened a senior readiness review. High confidence / contemporaneous / direct documented receipt / older inherited-warning lane.
gaps: Not a Hamas/Gaza attack warning. Long time gap means the 2018 condition cannot be assumed to have persisted through 2023. Knesset/IDF reviews disputed Brik’s overall diagnosis and found the IDF generally ready while acknowledging gaps.

warning_source: 800 former Shin Bet personnel / Shin Bet veterans for defending democracy
progress: Direct letter warned that continued judicial-overhaul legislation would create a real clear and immediate danger to national security; cited legal-operational exposure of Shin Bet/IDF personnel and urged preservation of the people’s army. High confidence / contemporaneous / direct documented receipt / moderately specific strategic warning.
gaps: Political-advocacy context preserved; source is a former-security professional group rather than an opposition party. Not a Hamas-specific forecast and no causal link to Oct 7 inferred. No direct public reply located; requested halt did not occur.
